note: args = [fn, args]: fn names an exported function of src/logic.ts and args is its argument list, so each case is {name, fn, args, expected}. Expected values are written by hand. The time math, range, format and queue cases are carried over from the Toggl twin with ids changed to text; millisecond values come from Python datetime, not from the TypeScript code. Clockify rules checked here: X-Api-Key header, entry shape with timeInterval (end null while it runs), tag ids, stop and create bodies, and the plugin's own cap of 120 requests an hour with back off on 429 and 5xx (api.clockify.me/api/v1 docs, raw copy in research/obsidian-run/raw/b4). Clockify documents no quota for a personal key, so the cap is the plugin's own choice.
